function: DCCN learns RIS phase shifts from channel state to maximize rate; PPO also learns BS sleep, cell zooming and user association, above PHY (p. 6, 9).
system: 3 single-antenna BSs, 5 single-antenna users, one shared passive reflecting RIS with 128 elements and 3-bit phase shifts, 20 MHz bandwidth; carrier frequency not stated (p. 3, 10).
method: PPO actor-critic (reinforcement learning, fully connected, 128 neurons) for sleep, zooming, association; DCCN of two fully connected networks Na and Nb, label-free training on capacity loss (p. 7-9).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rician BS-RIS and RIS-user links, Rayleigh BS-user link, own path-loss exponents; FTP mode 3 traffic; fixed positions; no dataset or measurements (p. 4-6, 10).
test_conditions: Default setting (3 BSs, 5 users, fixed positions); sweeps over packet size, inter-arrival time and number of users; training versus testing conditions are not stated separately (p. 10-13).
baselines: Non-learned: AA (BSs always active). Learned: DQN-optimized DSZR. Ablations: PPO with only sleep (PS), only zooming (PZ), or both without RIS (PSZ); fewer sleep levels (p. 10, 12).
metrics: System energy consumption (J) over time, packet size, inter-arrival time and users; PPO versus DQN reward convergence; number of active BSs; percentage energy saving (p. 10-13).
q1_support: p. 4: "follows the Rician fading model"; custom Rician and Rayleigh simulator with own path-loss exponents (Table II, p. 10); reference [40] (3GPP TR 38.913) is cited only for the FTP mode 3 traffic model (p. 6, 13); no standardized channel or measured data.
q2_support: p. 13: "Fig 14 illustrates the impact of the number of users on system energy consumption"; only sweeps of users, packet size (p. 11) and inter-arrival time (p. 12) are shown, with no statement that the policy was trained in a different setting; state and action sizes depend on N (p. 7).
q3_support: p. 10: "a DQN-optimized SM assisted by cell zooming and RIS (DSZR) as benchmarks" (learned DQN baseline); p. 10: "a scheme without any energy-saving techniques and optimization algorithms (AA)" (non-learned baseline); p. 13: "the proposed PSZR scheme achieves the lowest energy consumption" (energy is the paper metric).
q4_support: p. 6: "a pre-trained method that has lower prediction complexity"; qualitative only. No complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime is reported; Table II (p. 10) lists layers and neurons only.
q5_support: p. 10: "the locations of the BSs and users are randomly generated"; channels and traffic are simulated (p. 4-6) and no code or data link, DOI or public dataset is given.
notes: Included under the joint rule of the above_phy check: PPO learns sleep mode, cell zooming and user association (above PHY), while DCCN learns RIS phase shifts (area 3, p. 6, 9). Preprint arXiv 2412.18983v1 (p. 1). The baselines address the overall energy objective; only the no-RIS variant PSZ isolates the RIS design. TR 38.913 is for traffic only.
